newsitem.title: USA: Stone sells forest products assets.
newsitem.headline: Stone sells forest products assets.

text.p: Stone Container Corp said Thursday it sold the majority of the operating assets of its forest products division to U.S. Forest Industries Inc, a new corporation formed by management of the division and an investment group.
Stone said it expects to report an estimated $10 million after-tax charge against earnings in the third quarter as a result of the transaction.

Stone said sales of these assets, along with the previously announced liquidation of certain other forest products assets, are expected to provide Stone with proceeds in excess of $100 million, the majority of it in cash.
Stone said it will use the proceeds from this transaction primarily to repay and reduce outstanding indebtedness.

Forest products assets involved in the current deal produce and sell a variety of wood products, including softwood lumber, plywood, wood chips and veneer. Revenues for the operations being sold exceeded $100 million in 1995.
Stone said its fiber procurement operations, which provide the essential raw materials for its paper mills, are not included in the sale.

Stone said it has not considered forest products as one of its core businesses. Sale of these assets will allow it to concentrate on core areas of containerboard, corrugated containers, paper bags and sacks, market pulp, and newsprint and groundwood papers.
